Your work As a rotating engineer / field service you are part of a team of service engineers who are specialized in speed and vibration measurement systems to monitor and protect turbines, compressors, gear boxes, and other large rotating machinery. You work with machine guidelines, ATEX and SIL, and you are faced with the challenge of performing retrofits on existing machines with new systems. With a small team you are responsible for the engineering, installation, commissioning and lifetime support of these critical systems. You will be trained internally and develop into a specialist in measurement systems and an important knowledge partner for the customer. You work for many large customers in the energy, chemical and petrochemical sectors in the Benelux and you make the difference with your thoroughness, insight and perseverance. Your work is varied and challenging; We work hard on challenging projects, but with a strong safety net from your colleagues.
